implementation: Round 2 Receiving Manager (Sai charan, @cherryy-x23), ported to Round 3. One batched Gemini call per delivery reads the photos (it is not shown the purchase order and decides nothing); fixed rules compare what it read with the PO line. No model key, no photos or a model error gives a pending record, not a guess. The real model has not been run through this pod; tests use a scripted model. See agents/receiving/README.md and PROVENANCE.md.
notes: Needs GEMINI_API_KEY for live checks. Photos go in data/input/<unit_id>/receiving/. Tests use a scripted model and need no key.
